SIG-C45.title: Current audio measurements do not establish a full machine-voice profile
SIG-C45.support: Duration, RMS, peak, channel count, and low-energy fractions are present. Robust F0, segmentation/rate controls, aligned state comparisons, and other protocol requirements are not completed here.
SIG-C45.counterevidence_and_limits: The rendered coverage is strong and all 666 direct semantic lines have four-language evidence. Coverage and interpretive maturity are different axes.
SIG-C45.revision_or_falsification_condition: A complete documented machine pipeline applied to the actual media could warrant upgrading the state; copying the present statistics into prose cannot.
